description: Internal: reactively reload the in-memory configuration snapshot and fan out provider model discovery after configuration changes.

request_schema.description: Advisory configuration-change event delivered to `router::on_config_changed`. The handler ignores event values and re-fetches the authoritative entry before replacing its in-memory snapshot.
request_schema.title: ConfigChangedEvent

response_schema.description: Generic acknowledgement returned by trigger-bound handlers whose result is not consumed by callers (kept typed so the response schema is concrete).
response_schema.title: RouterAck
